mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 4% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL > 4% month-over-month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the civilian labor force participation rate (UNRATE) above 62.5% for two consecutive months signals a tighter labor market, which increases wage pressures and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 62.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above 1.2 million units for three consecutive months signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction and related equities and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1.2 million units for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST > 1.2 million units for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 98 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 98 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 250,000 for three consecutive months signals robust labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 250,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
